defs.def: the things that are contained in sth 所容纳之物；所含之物；内容

ex.s: However, psychologists have demonstrated that when adults read news stories, they remember more of the content than if they listen to or view identical pieces.
ex.t: 然而,心理学家已经证明,当成年人阅读新闻故事时,比起聆听或观看相同的片段,他们对内容的记忆更多.

ex.s: What do we know about the content of The Idler?
ex.t: 关于《闲人》的内容我们知道什么？

ex.s: Meaning emerges through a process of social interaction, not of computation, interaction that shapes the content of the symbols in our heads.
ex.t: 意义通过社会互动的过程产生，而非计算——这种互动塑造了我们头脑中符号的内容。

ex.s: They reduced their products’ sugar content.
ex.t: 他们减少了产品中的糖含量。

ex.s: PASS doesn’t re-teach or deliver new content.
ex.t: PASS不重新讲授或不传授新内容。

ex.s: Our content is about real-life topics that are relevant because we know what matters to you is what sticks best You will, find it very rewarding to learn with Lancom.
ex.t: 我们的内容是关于现实生活中的话题，这些话题相关，因为我们知道对你重要的东西才记得最牢。你会发现，和Lancom一起学习非常有收获。

ex.s: The informative content.
ex.t: 个性化课程               B. 多种语言

ex.s: There has been a recent trend in the food service industry toward lower fat content and less salt.
ex.t: 近来食品服务业出现了降低脂肪含量和减少盐用量的趋势。

ex.s: By introducing some of its contents.
ex.t: 最有价值的公司是谷歌、亚马逊、Facebook和微软。

ex.s: Although not every paragraph needs a subheading, they can be skimmed to give the reader an overall understanding of the content of a text.
ex.t: 虽然不是每个段落都需要小标题，但浏览小标题可以让读者对文本内容有一个整体的了解。

ex.s: To serve its function, a book must be activated by a user: the cover opened, the pages parted, the contents reviewed, perhaps notes written down or words underlined.
ex.t: 为了发挥其功能，一本书必须由使用者来激活：打开封面，翻开书页，浏览内容，也许还要写下笔记或划出字句。

ex.s: And are listening to and viewing content as effective as reading the written word when covering the same material?
ex.t: 在学习同样的材料时，听和看内容与阅读文字一样有效吗？

ex.s: Our courses, totalling 20,000 hours of content in 20 different languages, guarantee you language skills you can use right away.
ex.t: 我们的课程总计2万小时内容，涵盖20种不同的语言，保证你掌握可立即使用的语言技能。

defs.def: the different sections that are contained in a book （书的）目录，目次
the subject matter of a book, speech, programme, etc. （书、讲话、节目等的）主题，主要内容

ex.s: Visual information, such as photos and illustrations, can support reading and help you identify the theme and content of a text.
ex.t: 视觉信息，如照片和插图，可以帮助阅读，并帮助你确定文本的主题和内容。

ex.s: Since April drinks companies have been forced to pay between 18p and 24p for every litre of sugary drink they produce or import, depending on the sugar content.
ex.t: 自4月份以来，饮料公司被迫为其生产或进口的每升含糖饮料支付18便士至24便士不等的费用，具体取决于含糖量。

defs.def: the amount of a substance that is contained in sth else 用于名词后
the information or other material contained on a website or CD-ROM （网站或只读光盘上的）内容，目录
happy and satisfied with what you have 满意；满足

ex.s: If you ever get the impression that your dog can "tell" whether you look content or annoyed, you may be onto something.
ex.t: 如果你得到的印象是 你的狗可以"说" 无论你看起来满足或烦恼, 你可能会在的东西。

ex.s: All over the world you can see kids playing to their hearts' content with a ball made of plastic bags; just like Pelé did when he was a boy.
ex.t: 你知道吗，秋季\/冬天即将来临。

ex.s: Future 3D food printers could make processed food healthier． Hod Lipson， a professor at Columbia University， said， "Food printing could allow consumer to print food with customized nutritional content， like vitamins． So instead of eating a piece of yesterday 's bread from the supermarket， you'd eat something baked just for you on demand．"
ex.t: 未来的3D食品打印机可以让加工食品更健康。哥伦比亚大学教授霍德·利普森说：“食品打印可以让消费者打印出具有定制营养含量的食物，比如维生素。所以，你不必吃超市里昨天烤的面包，而是可以随时吃到专门为你现烤的食物。”

ex.s: Did Nielsen then feel content in his career?
ex.t: Nielsen当时对自己的事业感到满足吗？

ex.s: Curious Minds Never Feel Contented
ex.t: 好奇的心灵从不感到满足

defs.def: willing to do sth 愿意
to accept and be satisfied with sth and not try to have or do sth better 满足；满意；知足
to make sb feel happy or satisfied 使满意；使满足
